facts.business: JK Lakshmi Cement Ltd. manufactures and sells cement and allied products, operating integrated plants and grinding units across India with a focus on low carbon solutions.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Achieve a turnover of INR 30,000 Crores by 2030
Be in the top three companies in the industry in terms of EBIDTA per ton margins
Leverage digital capabilities to drive growth and create long-term value for stakeholders
Develop innovative solutions with a compelling value proposition, expand asset footprint, and venture into new business opportunities contributing 40% of the business

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided text
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Comparative financial statements for year ended March 31, 2025 were audited by preceding auditor who expressed an unmodified opinion dated August 1, 2025. No modification in respect of this matter.

key_risks: Revenue recognition complexity due to discounts, incentives and rebates across marketing regions
Capital expenditure timing and capitalization criteria under Ind AS 16 for assets constructed/installed by the company
